clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around Bea's birth in March 1995, within the year: your mother worn out and on edge by August, your parents in distance by November, you with stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah in shouting matches with your father by May, and your mother not going back to her job by September. The shifts pile up across the family in the months after the birth, each one near another's, and the period settles where your mother's functioning stays down and the rest stay as they were.
